email.subject: Harbor Falls HVAC site: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I checked out Cool Breeze Group's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: it isn't mobile-friendly, so anyone searching "HVAC near me" on their phone (most people) hits a clunky page and leaves, and there's no click-to-call button, so they have to copy your number instead of just tapping to call. On top of that, there's no booking option and no reviews shown, both of which make people trust and choose you less.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what's hurting you most?

Alex
